references.text: Jesus' answer confirms that He existed before Abraham, which directly refutes the Jews' claim that He could not have seen Abraham due to His young age.
Jesus' statement that Abraham 'rejoiced' to see His day provides context for the Jews' question about how Jesus could have seen Abraham.
Abraham's age of 99 years at Isaac's birth establishes the timeline the Jews use to argue against Jesus having seen Abraham.
Abraham's age of 100 years at Isaac's birth underscores the vast time gap between Abraham and Jesus, which is the core of the Jews' doubt.
Jesus' discussion about knowing and honoring God, along with His claim that Abraham was glad to see His day, leads directly to the question of Abraham's view of Jesus.
